Second quoted row: '2026-02-28 | MARAL OVERSEAS LIMITED | ... 100% Cotton Single Jersey Dyed Knitted fabric FGSM-160 PDM 087138 Shade :-Black | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | DHAKA, Bangladesh | 60062200 | BOL 1116395'. domestic_evidence: Company site https://www.maraloverseas.com/ states 'We have now three ultra modern units based at Maral, Sarovar and Noida, and is able to produce 1700 of Grey Yarn, 300 tons of Dyed Yarn, 700 tons of Dyed Knitted Fabric and 5,00,000 pieces of garments every month' and 'earned its reputation in the national as well as international market' — capacity and self-description only, no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report domestic/export split was retrieved. Investor-relations subpages tried (/investor-relations/, /financial-results/) returned HTTP 404. GST turnover band: null (not public in what was retrieved).
note: Legal entity MARAL OVERSEAS LIMITED is real and active in customs data; it is a vertically integrated textile manufacturer (yarn, knit fabric, garments) of the LNJ Bhilwara Group, not a food/FMCG trader. Export shipments are factually confirmed with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (Germany 61091000 B/L 1116704; Bangladesh 60062200 B/L 1116395, both 2026-02-28), plus 35373 claimed total records and 114 counterparties. The division name 'MARAL FASHIONS' returns an empty ImportKey page (no separate shipment records) — it ships under the parent's name, so no separate evidence exists for the division. Declared HS 520526/520528 (cotton yarn, fine count) does not match the observed export lines (61091000 knitted T-shirts, 60062200 knitted fabric); per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the actual observed codes should be recorded as 61091000 / 60062200 (plus yarn lines likely present in the unviewed 35373 records). Domestic supply: only capacity claims, no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found — status declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in retrieved sources, not invented).
